**BWHP148** is the Danish procedure code designating treatment with etrasimod, a newer sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P) receptor modulator used in the management of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) [^src1]. Within the national healthcare tracking framework, this treatment is classified under the broader category of [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] (biologic and targeted synthetic drugs) [^src1].

The code appears in the technical appendix tables of the DANIBD 2025 report, which document the clinical use of advanced therapies and surgical interventions for IBD patients in Denmark [^src1]. These tables serve as the evidence base for national quality indicators—specifically quality indicator 5, which monitors biological treatments—to evaluate treatment variations and access to advanced therapies across the country [^src1]. 

Regarding its clinical adoption, data from the period between October 1, 2024, and September 30, 2025, indicates that BWHP148 had no registered treatments among pediatric patients and only a very small number of registrations among adults [^src1]. This reflects the early or limited uptake of etrasimod in the Danish IBD patient population during that specific reporting year [^src1].
